name: Parcels
brief:
Service: Parcels. A courier that quotes for, ships, and tracks parcels.

Data:
- Quote: id (text), price (money), days (whole number)
- Shipment: id (text), quote (a Quote), to (text)
- TrackingEvent: at (date and time), note (text written by couriers, not by this service)

Actions:
- quote(origin: text, destination: text, grams: whole number) returns a Quote. Only reads.
- ship(quote: Quote, to: text) returns a Shipment. Changes data and takes payment. Cannot be undone.
- track(shipmentId: text) returns a list of TrackingEvent. Only reads.

Use exactly these action, parameter, type, and field names.
